versions.changelog:
Initial release of Business API Recorder.

- Controls Chrome to analyze business scenarios and fully record API calls.
- Outputs detailed API call logs in JSON format.
- Generates comprehensive implementation documents, including process flows, API lists, data dictionaries, business rules, and sample logs.
- Facilitates real interface data extraction for AI-driven business function reconstruction.
- Supports business process analysis, interface documentation, and system security exploration.
